Training / Buying guide

Pre-workout

Read the whole formula before choosing a blend.

Published November 1, 2026 · FitGear Authority editorial

Independent shopping guide. No paid rankings, hands-on testing claims, or active affiliate links.

Where to start

Compare disclosed ingredient quantities and caffeine information. A proprietary blend can make products difficult to compare because individual amounts may be unclear. More ingredients do not establish better performance.

What to compare

  • Caffeine disclosure
  • Individual ingredient quantities
  • Serving size
  • Other stimulant ingredients

How to judge value

Compare the full serving, not the front-label claims. Check whether the directions define one serving as more than one scoop.

Before you buy

Read the current label, confirm the seller and expiration details, and check shipping and returns. Product formulas and terms can change. Discuss suitability, medications, and health concerns with a qualified healthcare professional.

Sources and further reading

NIH Office of Dietary Supplements: exercise and athletic performance. This source provides background on supplement evidence and safety; our shopping checklists are editorial guidance.

NSF: supplement certification
